summary.text: Jim Casha, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 8th District to Kristen McDonald Rivet.
Casha advanced from the party's April 25, 2026 convention, and little biographical information is available in public sources.
Jim Casha received 0.3% of the vote to Kristen McDonald Rivet's 55.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
